newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan unveils package to boost capital markets.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan unveils package to boost capital markets.

text.p: Pakistani Finance Minister Sartaj Aziz unveiled a package of tax exemptions on Tuesday to boost foreign and local investment and develop capital markets.
"Our government is keen to launch a comprehensive programme for sustained and balanced development of the capital market," he told a news conference.

He said the government had decided to extend capital gains tax exemption, due to expire on June 30, 1998 for three more years, totally exempt bonus shares from tax and remove a 0.5 percent turnover tax on the sale or purchase of shares.

The measures were part of a drive to stimulate investment in the equity market, Aziz said, adding that some of them would be implemented in the next few days and some in the June budget for fiscal 1997/98 (July-June).
He said foreign investment in government securities and corporate fixed income securities will also be made tax-free.
